_comment: Example claude-code-router config: keep Opus (Anthropic) as the orchestrator/default and route high-volume 'background' + long-context work to GLM 5.2 (Z.ai). Copy to ~/.claude-code-router/config.json, fill in keys, then run 'ccr code'. VERIFY the exact GLM model id at https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5.2 before relying on it — the id below is a placeholder.

Router._comment: default + think = the orchestrator (premium). background + longContext = cheap workers.
